decision: Expose three explicit SourceTree fields; retain state_tree as the bridge-state tree.

tree_fields.source_tree: SourceTree captured after both seeded results for the exact source DirectoryIdentity.path.
tree_fields.trusted_state_tree: SourceTree captured at the same completed preparation point for trusted_state DirectoryIdentity.path.
tree_fields.state_tree: SourceTree captured at the same completed preparation point for bridge_state DirectoryIdentity.path.

ownership: base must be absent. Require canonical private same-owner mode0700 parent. prepare_fixture creates base0700 once. Any partial base stays as evidence and blocks automatic reuse; close never removes it.
close: Same existing contract: close only the owned fixture server, idempotently; no deletion or lifecycle mirroring.
verification: Each returned tree root must exactly match its directory field. The later root acceptance check rederives all three unchanged trees after the one model read. Hashes/census only are public evidence; no file contents or target/prediction payloads in the returned record or logs.
authority: Only resolves the output shape and confirms the already proposed ownership pattern. No change to source/mock-only tests, resource limits, or execution holds.
